description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Resolvers' that creates expression resolvers for handling messaging in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for generating resolvers for outbound signals, inbound external messages, and other messaging entities, mainly by configuring placeholders for message headers, topics, and connection identifiers.

classes.name: Resolvers
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to create expression resolvers for messaging purposes, including inbound/outbound signals and messages.

methods.name: getPlaceholders
methods.description: Returns an array of all the placeholders used for target address and header mappings in messaging.

methods.name: forOutbound
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for an outbound message based on a mapped outbound signal and connection ID.

methods.name: forSignal
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for a given signal and connection ID.

methods.name: forExternalMessage
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for an external message received on a specific connection.

methods.name: forOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for a mappable outbound signal and connection ID.

methods.name: forInbound
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for an inbound external message, with associated signal, topic, and authorization data.
